name: MVGS_CS_HOSPITALIZATION_PERIODS
title: MV-GenomSeq hospitalisation periods (banded count, last five years)
description: Number of inpatient treatments in the last five years, banded as delivered by the BfArM Datenkranz (KDK rare disease case.priorRds[].hospitalizationPeriods). Interim until the Seltene module ships a concept (ballot comment HDB-975; DISCUSS-TD #33, REPRESENTATIONS #33). Band codes are the KDK literals; 'unknown' is not a code (Observation.dataAbsentReason). The concept 'hospitalization-periods' is the Observation.code; it is not part of the value set mvgs-vs-hospitalization-periods (band codes only), so CodeSystem.valueSet (whole code system) is not set.

concept.display: Number of inpatient treatments in the last five years (banded)
concept.definition: Number of inpatient stays related to the rare disease in the five years before the current case (KDK hospitalizationPeriods).
